title: 3 AL/BC testing patterns from an external BC testing expert's blog (Luc van Vugt, fluxxus.nl)
summary: Adds three AL testing knowledge articles drawn from Luc van Vugt's blog: excluding known invalid relations in Table Relation Test through the OnAfterRemoveTableRelation event, committing shared fixture data inside a lazy Initialize(), and using Assert.IsFalse rather than asserterror around Assert.IsTrue.
key_points: Table Relation Test's OnAfterRemoveTableRelation event can exclude known invalid relations
Shared fixture data created in a lazy Initialize() needs an explicit Commit() or it rolls back after the first test
Use Assert.IsFalse for boolean checks; asserterror only verifies an error was raised
The Table Relation Test hook was checked against BCApps source
A Confirm/StrSubstNo candidate and two other candidates were dropped
quote: mined from a source outside CURABIS itself: Luc van Vugt's fluxxus.nl, a long-running blog by a BC/NAV developer
